configs.description: The cable manager as Hubbell ships HM144C, the cover fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with the cover taken off, the five rings in front of the plate in view.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: the HM144C sheet (PREM-HM144C-SPEC-EN) gives no dimensions table and no material; the width, the height, the wire and the finish are the HM14C's.
gaps.wanted: the dimensioned customer drawing, or a dimensions table for the HM144C

gaps.note: the sheet's figure shows each wire ring bent round where it leaves the plate and at its free end, with a hook on the post of alternate rings, and dimensions none of it. The side views draw the loop with a 11.43 mm corner radius (two wire diameters), a stand-in; the 3D loop keeps square corners and no hook is drawn. The rings are drawn in a mid steel tone so they read against the black plate; the sheet states none.
gaps.wanted: the dimensioned customer drawing, or the maker's figure for the ring's bend and hook

gaps.note: the sheet's figure shows a folded edge along the cover, the HM24C photograph a lip along the top and a name plate at the middle. The face draws a 6 mm fold along the top and foot and the plate's 58 by 12 mm box blank; the fold's width is a stand-in.
the page says "Cover Type Hinge"; the format has no hinge, so the cover is one panel drawn fitted, and the `cover-off` configuration is the cover taken off.
gaps.wanted: a format for a hinge; nothing the maker could add

gaps.note: the page states no count of cables, nor a basis for one.
gaps.wanted: a maker's figure with its basis
`attrs.physical.weight-kg` (profile `passive` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: borrowed - material, wire diameter and finish from the HM14C sheet; "Black" and the hinged cover are on the HM144C page, whose title says "Black" and whose table says "Cover Type Hinge"; the UPC is its table's.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - the page states no cable capacity, so none is stated here and none is estimated.

chassis.note: borrowed - 482.6 x 44.45 x 204.7, the HM14C's width and height (see `method`); depth is the 4 in front extension and the 4 in rear extension the HM144C sheet states, with the plate's 1.5 mm (estimated) between them.

ears.note: estimated - `positions` states where the part bolts, for the Rack Builder. The plate is the part's own ears, so the rail plane is the back of the plate: the front rings stand 101.6 out of its front, and the plate is 1.5 thick (estimated), so `at` is 103.1. The page lists no accessories and no rail kit, so `kits` is not stated.

front.note: estimated - the HM14C's front: the plate with its four windows, five wire rings and the cover, read off the HM14C figure against its B. The HM144C's own page shows a photograph only (four windows, rings, a front cover), which agrees in count. The cover is drawn fitted; the `cover-off` configuration leaves it off and shows the rings.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the rings reach 101.6 in front of the rail and 101.6 behind it, not the depth of the rack, so the rack unit's rear face is not claimed.

left.note: estimated - an elevation, rear on the left: each ring's wires and post, either side of the plate's edge. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: borrowed - HM14C (library device hubbell/hm14c). Hubbell's spec sheet for the HM144C, PREM-HM144C-SPEC-EN.pdf (hubbellcdn.com, REV 8/2026; sha256 below), is a catalogue page with a title, a list of five features and a table of four rows: "M-Series", "1-Unit", "4 in Front Extension", "4 in Rear Extension", "With Cover", Type "Horizontal Cable Management", Cover Type "Hinge", Industry Standard "EIA", UPC 662620665313. It has no dimensions table, no figure with dimensions and no material. The older sheet layout, PREMISE_HM144C_spec.pdf, does not exist (HTTP 404, checked 2026-10-18). Its "Customer Drawing [English]" link is a CAD file, hubbellcdn.com/customerusedrawing/ HWS14421C-HM1xx_1U_HOR_CBL_ORG.dwg (AutoCAD 2018 format, 382,784 bytes), which nothing on the build host opens, so it was not read. So the 1 RU height and the 19 in width are the HM14C's (same unit count, same figure) and the wire and finish are the HM14C sheet's; what this page states is the 4 in rear extension and the hinged cover.

rear.note: estimated - five rings behind the plate, the front's seen from behind, as the HM14C figure draws them; the rear extension that stands them out is stated, 4 in.

rear-extension.note: datasheet - 4 in, 101.6 mm: the HM144C sheet's "4 in Rear Extension", beside its "4 in Front Extension". This is the one part of the line whose rear rings are stated. The HM14C, HM24C and HM34C figures mark a rear dimension D that no table gives; for those three it is estimated from this part's 4 in.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.5 mm. No Hubbell sheet states the plate's gauge for the M-Series.

top.note: estimated - an elevation: the plate's edge and the ten rings' top wires, five behind it and five in front. The cover's edge is not drawn.
